create.name: Dr. Ed Bastian
create.bio:
Ed Bastian is an American meditation teacher and the founder and president of the Spiritual Paths Foundation, a non-profit that runs his interspiritual courses online. His training was in Buddhism: he earned a doctorate in Buddhist studies and Western philosophy at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, guided by Geshe Lhundup Sopa, spent the best part of a decade studying with monks in the United States, India and the Himalayas, and went to India as a Fulbright scholar to read Indian philosophy and translate Tibetan and Sanskrit texts. Later he directed programmes on religion at the Smithsonian and produced films on Asian religious life for the BBC and PBS.

His main method, InterSpiritual Meditation, is a seven-step sitting practice built from many contemplative traditions. It moves from intention and gratitude through compassion, breath awareness and wisdom to service, so that people of any faith, or none, can shape a meditation that fits them. A second process, the InterSpiritual Mandala, helps students map their spiritual styles and big questions into a path of their own. He teaches both as eight-week courses on Zoom, supported by trained mentors, and has written books on each, as well as Living Fully, Dying Well with Tina Staley. He has also taught Buddhism and mindfulness at Antioch University.

books.title: InterSpiritual Meditation: A Seven-Step Process from the World's Spiritual Traditions
books.author: Edward W. Bastian
books.description: The handbook for his seven-step meditation, which draws on many faiths so that readers can put together a daily practice of their own and share it with others.

books.title: Mandala: Creating an Authentic Spiritual Path
books.author: Edward W. Bastian
books.description: A workbook-style guide to his Mandala process, in which readers explore their own spiritual styles and questions and choose teachers and practices to match.

books.title: Living Fully, Dying Well: Reflecting on Death to Find Your Life's Meaning
books.author: Edward W. Bastian and Tina Staley
books.description: Conversations with teachers from several traditions on facing our own mortality, and on how reflecting on death can deepen the way we live now.

courses.title: InterSpiritual Meditation Course
courses.description: An eight-week live course on Zoom in which students build their own seven-step meditation, with recordings, a journaling tool, forums and support from mentors.

courses.title: InterSpiritual Mandala Course
courses.description: An eight-week course on finding a personal spiritual path by working through your spiritual styles and questions across many traditions, with live sessions and mentors.

free_resources.title: InterSpiritual Meditation: Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: Free guided videos of the seven-step practice in several versions and lengths, in English and Spanish, with waves, silence or sacred music.
